segments.name: Investment Banking
segments.description: Single reportable segment providing investment banking advisory, capital markets, treasury, investment and wealth management services to Brazilian corporate, institutional and high-income clients.
segments.evidence: The Group has a single reportable segment as of December 31, 2025, and 2024. This segment offers investment banking services, which are administered and managed according to the products offered.

revenueModel.text: Corporate, institutional and high-income clients pay advisory and service fees for investment banking, capital markets, treasury and wealth management services.
revenueModel.evidence: We generate investment banking revenue based on advisory service fees that are calculated as a percentage of the completed transaction.
